transcripts.transcript: I have been waiting here for two hours. Where on earth have you been? I called you three times and nobody answered. So I just walked over here. I am sorry, my phone was dead. The battery never lasts a whole day. And then my train was cancelled, so I walked. In this awful weather? You are crazy. Yes, I know. But I am here now. No! No! Wait! Stop! That is my bus. Never mind, the next one comes at 8. Have you got the keys? Of course I have got the keys. I only forgot them for a moment. My friend Sarah has lived in London since 2015. We wanted to visit her today. Then we need to hurry. I will grab a quick coffee, and you call her. Tell her that we are running late. She knows me, she never waits long anyway. Right, let us go. This time I really managed it.
